hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: For each string, find the shortest substring that does not appear in any other string.

hints.title: Key Observation
hints.text: Each word has length at most 20, so all substrings can be generated and compared directly.

hints.title: Algorithmic Steps
hints.text: Generate substrings of arr[i], sort by length and lexicographical order, and return the first one absent from all arr[j] with j does not equal i.

hints.title: Implementation

variables: n: number of words in arr
L: maximum length of word (at most 20)
complexity.notes: Substring generation and cross-containment checks for small L.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Trie or suffix tree optimization is possible but direct enumeration works well for L <= 20.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Sort candidate substrings by length then lexicographically, returning the first unique one.
